introduction: North Dakota Medicaid has several coverage categories. Apply through the state Self-Service Portal or choose the paper form that matches your circumstances.
description: North Dakota Medicaid has several coverage categories. Apply through the state Self-Service Portal or choose the paper form that matches your circumstances.

sections.who: Expansion generally covers qualifying adults ages 19–64 who do not qualify for another Medicaid category or Medicare. The state also assesses children, pregnancy, disability and older-adult categories separately.
sections.get: Approved medical coverage depends on the category and plan. Ask about a specific service before assuming every Medicaid category has identical benefits.

sections.apply:
1. Choose the application

    Use the Medicaid application page. Its paper forms differ for medical-only, combined benefits and elderly or disabled applicants.

  2. Submit to the state

    Online applications use the Self-Service Portal; paper applications return to a Human Service Zone.

  3. Answer notices

    Supply requested records and read each household member’s decision.
sections.after: Keep contact information current and respond to renewal requests. For application assistance, the Customer Support Center lists 866-614-6005.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Current Medicaid categories, Application forms and help. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can household members get different results?
Yes. The state evaluates the applicable coverage category for each applicant.
Which paper form should I use?
The application page identifies SFN 1909, 405 and 958 for different situations.
Does expansion automatically include every service?
Coverage varies by category and plan. Confirm the particular service with your coverage administrator.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
